title: Geometric neighbourhood and residue-triple diagram comparison
statement: Let A be a local commutative ring, K a separable closure of its residue field k, and Omega an algebraically closed extension of K, with compatible k-algebra structures. Suppose the relative separable closure of k in Omega is exactly the image of K. Form the geometric point x from A -> k -> K -> Omega, and the residue point (p,chi) from A -> k -> K, as in def-wf-geometric-triples-comparison-maps. The residue embedding at every affine pointed etale neighbourhood of x lands in K. For every small representative equivalence r:J -> N_x, every universal cocone c of the residue-triple ring diagram at (A,p,K,chi), and every qA:c.pt -> K with the prescribed values on all coprojections: each r(j) has a representing triple t with its ring exactly the coordinate ring; there are a structural map b:A -> G and an invertible ring map g:c.pt -> G, where G is the colimit of the r-indexed coordinate ring diagram. Every chart followed by its geometric coprojection is b; g satisfies GeometricTriplesCoprojections; every triple structural map followed by c.ι and g is b. For every j, its evaluation is its coprojection followed by g inverse, qA and K -> Omega. Every ring map satisfying the same represented coprojection equations equals g. No arbitrary henselian algebra is part of this statement.

proof.text: Apply etale_local_ring_triples to the identity chart. The base prime is the maximal ideal. Transport its relative separable closure to K using the supplied equality of images. Finite separability of each etale residue field gives containment in K.

Compose the affine-neighbourhood equivalence with strictHenselizationAffineInclusion and the representative equivalence r. Its chart and point formulas give the representing triples and GeometricTriplesRepresents. Restriction along r preserves the colimit.

Transport the universal cocones along this diagram equivalence to construct g and its inverse. Its formulas on coprojections are the required compatibility. The identity chart yields b, with both the chart and triple structural formulas. The point formula gives the displayed evaluation through inverse g. Every triple is isomorphic to a representative, so its coprojection equations determine g among all ring maps by colimit uniqueness.

theorem geometric_triples_diagram_comparison
    (A : CommRingCat.{u}) [IsLocalRing A]
    (K Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K] [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K]
    [Algebra K Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) Ω]
    [IsScalarTower (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) K Ω]
    (hsep : ∀ z : Ω, z ∈ separableClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) Ω ↔
      z ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K Ω)) :
    (∀ (n : strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods (geometricTriplesPoint A K Ω))
      (z : ((AffineEtale.Spec (Spec A)).obj n.1).left.residueField
        (SpecToEquivOfField Ω _ n.2.left).1),
      (SpecToEquivOfField Ω _ n.2.left).2 z ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K Ω)) ∧
    ∀ (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J]
      (r : J ⥤ strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods (geometricTriplesPoint A K Ω))
      [r.IsEquivalence]
      (c : Cocone (etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram A (geometricTriplesResiduePoint A K).1 K
        (geometricTriplesResiduePoint A K).2)) (hc : IsColimit c)
      (qA : c.pt ⟶ .of K)
      (hqA : ∀ t, c.ι.app t ≫ qA = geometricTriplesTripleResidue t),
      (∀ j : J, ∃ (t : EtaleResidueTriple A (geometricTriplesResiduePoint A K).1 K
        (geometricTriplesResiduePoint A K).2)
        (hB : t.B = (strictHenselizationCoordinateRings
          (geometricTriplesPoint A K Ω)).obj (op (r.obj j))),
        GeometricTriplesRepresents (r.obj j) t hB) ∧
      ∃ b : A ⟶ colimit (r.op ⋙ strictHenselizationCoordinateRings
          (geometricTriplesPoint A K Ω)),
        (∀ j : J, geometricTriplesChart (r.obj j) ≫
          colimit.ι (r.op ⋙ strictHenselizationCoordinateRings
            (geometricTriplesPoint A K Ω)) (op j) = b) ∧
        ∃ g : c.pt ⟶ colimit (r.op ⋙ strictHenselizationCoordinateRings
            (geometricTriplesPoint A K Ω)),
          GeometricTriplesCoprojections r c g ∧ ∃ (_ : IsIso g),
          (∀ t, t.α ≫ c.ι.app t ≫ g = b) ∧
          (∀ j : J, (inv g ≫ qA ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K Ω)).hom.comp
            (colimit.ι (r.op ⋙ strictHenselizationCoordinateRings
              (geometricTriplesPoint A K Ω)) (op j)).hom =
                (geometricTriplesEvaluation (r.obj j)).hom) ∧
          ∀ g' : c.pt ⟶ colimit (r.op ⋙ strictHenselizationCoordinateRings
              (geometricTriplesPoint A K Ω)),
            GeometricTriplesCoprojections r c g' → g' = g
